## AI Study Notes Generator from PDF Text

**Setup:**
1. Connect OpenAI API and Gmail OAuth2
2. POST to webhook: `{"text_content": "paste PDF text here...", "email": "student@example.com"}`

Generates structured notes, flashcards, and quiz questions from text content. Sends a beautifully formatted email with all study materials.
